subject: general
question:
Select the word which means the same as the group of words underlined in the given sentence.

These glass windows are so __old and one can’t even see through them__, they need to be replaced.
solution:
The correct answer is **Option 1)**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"Opaque"** means not allowing light to pass through; not transparent or translucent. (अपारदर्शी)

 
 
• **Example: **The bathroom window was made of **opaque** glass to ensure privacy.
 
 
 
• **"Dirty"** refers to something that is covered or marked with an unclean substance. (गंदा)
 
 
• **Example: **The children came back with **dirty** hands after playing in the mud.
 
 

Hence, we can infer that the correct word to describe glass windows that are so old and one can’t even see through them is **'Opaque'**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Dirty **(गंदा): Covered or marked with an unclean substance.

 
 
• **Example:** The children came back with **dirty **hands after playing in the mud.
 
 
 
• **Transparent **(पारदर्शी): Allowing light to pass through so that objects behind can be distinctly seen.
 
 
• **Example: **The water in the lake was so **transparent **that you could see the fish swimming below.
 
 
 
• **Black** (काला): The color of coal, ebony, and of outer space; opposite of white.
 
 
• **Example:** She wore a beautiful **black** dress to the evening party.
